svg.title: One governed pipeline turns raw events into trusted dashboards

text.tspan: One governed pipeline turns raw events into trusted dashboards
Lakeflow Connect ingests changes from operational apps; Auto Loader picks up new files.
Raw records land in bronze tables.
Pipelines clean and conform them into silver, then aggregate gold KPIs.
A SQL warehouse serves the gold tables.
Dashboards and Genie answer questions from the same governed data.
